summary: ph-common postinstall beacons installer hostname and paths to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: ph-common@99.0.1 is a stub package (description 'Compatibility shim.', main exports a Proxy-based no-op) whose only real behavior is a reconnaissance beacon. package.json declares scripts.postinstall = 'node beacon.cjs', which also fires on require. beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The implausibly high version number (99.0.1) on an otherwise empty 'common' package is consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal package name: the beacon tells the operator which organization or host resolved the public name instead of a private registry. No legitimate functionality is present to balance this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
